name: lcla
description: LightningChart LA - Language Agnostic data visualization

scripts.test: npm run test:host && npm run test:csharp && npm run test:flutter
scripts.test:csharp: cd packages/clients/csharp && dotnet build && dotnet test
scripts.prepare:flutter: cd packages/clients/flutter/lightning_chart_flutter && flutter pub get && cd example && flutter pub get && cd ../../../../../examples/flutter && flutter pub get
scripts.analyze:flutter: cd packages/clients/flutter/lightning_chart_flutter && flutter analyze && cd ../../../../examples/flutter && flutter analyze lib
scripts.release:flutter:check: npm run build:host && npm run prepare:flutter && npm run format:flutter && npm run analyze:flutter && npm run test:flutter && npm run publish:flutter:dry-run
scripts.build:host: cd packages/host && npm run build && cd ../.. && npm run copy:host
